## AI/ML Engineering for Government Modernization

Balans delivers sovereign, project-based data and AI solutions for public sector institutions. We build local, in-process, on-device solutions that guarantee data privacy, control, and full compliance with WCAG 2.2 AAA and FAIR principles--without vendor lock-in or long-term contracts.

## Clients Choose Balans When

*   They need a **completed project**, not another platform subscription
*   Their mandate has a **hard deadline**
*   **Budget constraints** rule out multi-year vendor relationships
*   Data assets must be processed on infrastructure they **can control or can audit**

## Why Government Modernization Needs a New Approach

Traditional government IT modernization is sold as a platform, a subscription, a dashboard, a multi-year contract that outlives the mandate it was built for. Balans works differently.

**Embedded, Scoped, Finished**
Our forward-deployed model puts an engineer directly on your mandate, working within your constraints until the deliverable is complete and handed over—not retained as ongoing expenditure.

**Built for Public Sector Reality**
- **Local-first, sovereign by default**: Data and models run on infrastructure you control
- **No vendor lock-in**: Deliverables include complete code, documentation, and training materials
- **Project-based**: Defined scope, defined end date, fits standard contracting vehicles
- **Standards-compliant from day one**: Built to WCAG 2.2 AAA and FAIR data principles

## What We Deliver

> Fix the data, make it actionable, add on advanced capabilities--while keeping compliance and sovereignty as underlying principles.

### Data Engineering
Custom pipelines, ETL, and modern analytical infrastructure that turn raw data into actionable assets, with scalability in mind. Ideal for departments consolidating legacy systems or preparing for open data initiatives.

### Reporting & Analytical Deliverables
Actionable insights through reports, notebooks, dashboards, and AI layers that draw on your project's data and your team's knowledge.

### AI/ML Engineering
From proof-of-concept to production, we build solutions for real-world problems with transparency and fairness at the core, specializing in on-device inference for maximum data control.

### Documented Strategy, Governance & Compliance
Align your data with organizational goals, regulatory requirements (ATIP, Privacy Act), and best practices (WCAG 2.2 AAA, FAIR). We help you pass departmental review the first time.

### Sovereign Tooling
Local, in-process, on-device inference and tooling by default—ensuring data sovereignty, privacy, and full auditability. No third-party cloud routing unless you explicitly choose it.

## Service Tiers

Every engagement is scoped before it's priced—the tiers below are for planning purposes, not a binding quote.

| Tier | Use Case | Typical timeline | Price range (CAD) |
|------|----------|------------------|-------------------|
| **Scope** | Forensic data audit, FAIR assessment, scoping report | 4–6 weeks | $7,500 – $9,500 |
| **Architect** | Data cleaning, vault/lake structuring, pipeline development | 8–12 weeks | $35,000 – $80,000 |
| **Enable** | End-to-end build, SQL/reporting layer, local LLM integration, training materials | 12 weeks+ | $85,000 – $140,000 |

*Final pricing depends on data volume, schema complexity, and current data quality. Scope tier required before Architect/Enable contracts.*
